content:
I wanted to draw category theorists' attention to the new map attribute, added in #37183. You can now tag lemmas with @[map], similar to @[reassoc]. It takes an equality of morphisms, say f ≫ g = h, and generates a lemma which is the result of applying any functor to that equality, and simplifying using Functor.map_comp and Functor.map_id, i.e. in this case you get for all functors F, F.map f ≫ F.map g = F.map h.

It is not being used at all right now, but please consider doing so in your PRs. Also, reviews are welcome on #43863 which starts adding it to some existing lemmas. The similar op attribute is also awaiting review: #38478.
Also ready for review: #38482 which allows to specialize to specific functors and simplifying further, see it in action e.g. here
